notes: workflow(name) resolves the local catalog; a missing name reports `workflow('name'): no workflow with that name. Available: ...`.
workflow({scriptPath}) loads through the same readable-path loader, rejects when the name-only gate is set, and reports the source-prefixed load/parse errors.

The child runs in a fresh hardened context with the parent's budget, timers and agent bridge; agent calls are forced onto the child phase, logs and console are prefixed with the child name, phase() is a noop and meta phases are not recorded.
The reserved phase is `▸ name`, with ` #N` for a repeated name; `▸ running dynamic workflow name` is logged before the run and `▸ name done`/`▸ name failed: ...` after it.
A child's workflow() rejects with the source one-level message; resolution failures are recorded against the reserved phase and rethrown to the parent script.
